inlines.v: DISPROPORTIONATE, adjective Not proportioned; unsymmetrical; unsuitable to something else, in bulk, from or value; inadequate. In a perfect form of the body, none of the limbs are disproportionate It is wisdom not to undertake a work with disproportionate means.
